title: Cookbook:Alfajores (Latin American Sandwich Cookies)
steps: Cream butter; add sugar and beat until fluffy.
Add egg and egg yolks one at a time, beating well. Beat in vanilla and lemon rind.
Sift together cornstarch, flour, baking powder, and salt. Add to batter and mix well.
Drop batter by small spoonfuls onto well-buttered baking sheet.
Bake at 350°F for 15 minutes. Remove immediately and cool.
Sandwich the cookies together with dulce de leche.
description: == Ingredients == * ½ cup (120 ml) butter * 1 cup (240 ml) white granulated sugar * 1 egg * 2 egg yolks * 1 tsp vanilla * 2 tsp lemon rind, grated * 1½ cup (360 ml) cornstarch * ½ cup (120 ml) flour * 1 tsp baking powder * ¼ tsp salt * Dulce de leche

'''Alfajores''' are a Latin-American sandwich [[Cookbook:Cookie|cookie]] filled with [[Cookbook:Dulce de Leche|dulce de leche]].

== Ingredients ==
* ½ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] (120 [[Cookbook:Milliliter|ml]]) [[Cookbook:Butter|butter]]
* 1 cup (240 ml) white granulated [[Cookbook:Sugar|sugar]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Egg|egg]]
* 2 egg [[Cookbook:Egg Yolk|yolks]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] [[Cookbook:Vanilla|vanilla]]
* 2 tsp [[Cookbook:Lemon|lemon]] rind, grated
* 1½ cup (360 ml) [[Cookbook:Cornstarch|cornstarch]]
* ½ cup (120 ml) [[Cookbook:Flour|flour]]
* 1 tsp [[Cookbook:Baking Powder|baking powder]]
* ¼ tsp [[Cookbook:Salt|salt]]
* [[Cookbook:Dulce de Leche|Dulce de leche]]

== Procedure ==

# [[Cookbook:Cream|Cream]] butter; add sugar and beat until fluffy.
# Add egg and egg yolks one at a time, beating well. Beat in vanilla and lemon rind.
# Sift together cornstarch, flour, baking powder, and salt. Add to batter and mix well.
# Drop batter by small spoonfuls onto well-buttered [[Cookbook:Baking Sheet|baking sheet]].
# Bake at 350°F for 15 minutes. Remove immediately and cool.
# Sandwich the cookies together with dulce de leche.
